text:
Male patients are often asked to bring their own electric razor because many hospitals don't supply razors, and an electric razor is less likely than a disposable blade to nick the skin, which lowers the risk of surgical-site infection. For surgery itself, guidelines generally favour clipping hair over shaving, so staff may tell you not to shave beforehand. Whether a given hospital supplies razors varies, and I haven't checked a specific policy.

CONFIDENCE: 70
